title: UAP-class objects coming down from the outer atmosphere south of Picatinny
place_text: Airspace south of Picatinny Arsenal, New Jersey

tellings.quote: And we had UAP class stuff popping up to the south of there, coming in from the outer atmosphere and hovering into place and going back into space.

plain: A former military helicopter pilot named Jake Barber says that in December 2024 he saw objects south of Picatinny Arsenal, a US Army research site in New Jersey, that he calls UAP, the government's term for unexplained flying objects. He says they came down from the outer atmosphere, hovered in place, and then went back into space. If true, something was moving freely between space and the sky over New Jersey.
